contract: Pure agent loop step in the core/operator shape over PatternStep v1 neutral maps: each model request built by PromptAssembly.build/2 from the history and the tool list of a ToolRegistry snapshot in the state; each proposal of a model turn kept or left out with a named tag; all actions of one turn (tool_call, nested_callable or ask_person) in one request; each result bounded by ToolResultLimit with store actions in a second request; declarations of a skill or a listing permitted only by the source kind of the called tool; refusals and failed calls as marked notices; one finish answered or stopped with a named reason. State within 65,536 bytes, loaded instructions within 16,384 bytes. No model call, tool call, clock, storage or process; no budget or authority check.
limits: No provider is called: each test input is a literal neutral map; that the providers accept the refusal rule is shown on Request.decode/2 and the pure translate/2 of the two ready providers only.
A model call or a tool call that did not complete is never tried again; no rule for a second Attempt; no memory, compaction or member message.
The step verifies no person: an applied person_answer is read as it is and is content with no authority; marking is no claim against prompt injection.
answered says that the model gave an answer, not that the work is done; no engine claim (the ready run engine refuses a stopped root finish and gives no result of a nested callable).
Selected Cure laws cover the two decisions over supplied classifications only; the step table, history, notices, bounds and each call into the composed Pieces have finite tests only.

grounding.claim: keep with name_ok false is not Kept for every value of well_formed, has_id, new_id and in_bound.
keep with well_formed false is not Kept for every value of name_ok, has_id, new_id and in_bound.
keep with has_id false is not Kept for every value of name_ok, well_formed, new_id and in_bound.
permit with source kind Other is Refused for every value of has_skill and has_listing.
permit with source kind HostListing and has_skill true is Refused for both values of has_listing.
Pinned Cure checks types and totality of the keep and permit decisions; the source audit finds no axioms, holes, unresolved, unaudited, opaque or unproved-total definitions.

Twenty-one named recorded-trace groups pass: final_answer, one_turn_one_request, unknown_tool, malformed_proposals, listing_changes_snapshot, outside_set_listing, declarations_by_source_kind, instruction_bound, proposal_without_id, engine_refusal_as_content, result_after_cancel, turn_limit, done_is_not_evidence, ask_and_answer, declaration_over_state_bound, repeated_id, over_call_bound, validator_disagreement, not_resolved, request_not_built, run_ended; plus new_refusals and laws_and_example (law check, source audit, checked example of a start, one tool turn and the answer). Each request passes PatternStep.decode/1, each model_call payload passes Request.decode/2 with 65,536 bytes, each state is plain data within 65,536 bytes. Negative controls: permit giving Permitted for Other fails the law check; a next model call at the first tool outcome fails one_turn_one_request. Finite scenarios, not a universal proof.
Pinned Cure compilation, reduction checking and BEAM decision semantics; compiler soundness not locally proved.

Pinned Elixir immutable maps and lists; the ready Contracts of workflow/pattern-step, workflow/tool-registry, workflow/tool-result-limit, workflow/prompt-assembly, workflow/untrusted-content and integration/ai-text, and the pure translate/2 of integration/ai-text-anthropic and integration/ai-text-openai, are reused unchanged.
The state bound is measured as the byte size of term_to_binary(state, [deterministic, {minor_version, 2}]), the measure of the ready run engine.

The engine records each input before the step reads it, gives only inputs of its Attempt and checks payload, budget, authority and approval for every action; the model-call binding gives the ai-text JSON view with tool_proposals; the tool binding maps each action to a real Adapter or nested callable, marks results truthfully and gives a declaration only for a skill load or a listing; the store and ask bindings, the verified person, a truthful source set with kinds captured at Run start, complete listings, a pure truthful estimate, a Run-wide unique id and spec values that fit the state bound and the bounds of the engine.

telemetry.contract: Pure step emits no observations; the engine owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Intrinsic spec operands and two fixed bounds (state 65,536 bytes, loaded instructions 16,384 bytes); no ambient or hot settings.

control.contract: No independent process; cancel and run_ended are pattern inputs, not operational commands.
